Permission resources changed: `dashboard.summary/allocation/progress` → `dashboard`, `admin.data-sheet/workflow` → `admin.data`. We need to create the new consolidated pages and remove old ones. ### Read these files first - `app/summary/page.tsx` — current summary page (to understand KPI logic) - `app/allocation/page.tsx` — current allocation page (to understand DashboardShell usage) - `app/progress/page.tsx` — current progress page - `app/data-sheet/page.tsx` — current data-sheet page - `app/workflow/page.tsx` — current workflow page - `components/summary-page.tsx` — KPI component (keep, reuse) - `components/allocation-table.tsx` — allocation component (keep, reuse) - `components/progress-board.tsx` — progress component (keep, reuse) - `components/admin-request-sheet.tsx` — first 10 lines for props - `components/admin-workflow-table.tsx` — first 10 lines for props - `lib/queries.ts` — look for getAdminRequestSheet, getAdminWorkflowMatrix signatures - `lib/permissions.ts` — check that `checkPermission` works with new resource name "dashboard" ### What to do #### 1. Create `components/dashboard-tabs.tsx` Client component with 3 tabs: "요약", "TO 배분표", "진행현황" ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; // Import SummaryPage, AllocationTable, ProgressBoard // Tab switching UI with active/inactive styling // Pass through all needed props ``` Tab button style: - Active: `background: #0a1f14; color: #fff; border: none; borderRadius: 6` - Inactive: `background: #fff; color: #333; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; borderRadius: 6` #### 2. Create `app/dashboard/page.tsx` Server component that: - Calls `requireUser()` + `checkPermission(user.role, "dashboard", "view")` - Fetches all data needed by all 3 tabs (summary KPI + allocation columns/rows + progress data) - Renders DashboardTabs with all props - Redirects to `/login` if no permission Use the SAME data fetching logic from the existing summary/allocation/progress pages. Merge them. #### 3. Create `app/data/page.tsx` Server component that: - Calls `requireUser()` + `checkPermission(user.role, "admin.data", "view")` - Fetches request sheet rows + workflow matrix data - Renders DataTabs with all props - Redirects to `/dashboard` if no permission #### 5. Update `app/page.tsx` Change redirect from `/summary` to `/dashboard`: ```tsx import { redirect } from "next/navigation"; export default function Home() { redirect("/dashboard"); } ``` #### 6. Delete old route files Delete these files: - `app/summary/page.tsx` - `app/allocation/page.tsx` - `app/progress/page.tsx` - `app/data-sheet/page.tsx` - `app/workflow/page.tsx` Also delete these directories if they become empty: - `app/summary/` - `app/allocation/` - `app/progress/` - `app/data-sheet/` - `app/workflow/` Do NOT delete the component files (summary-page.tsx, allocation-table.tsx, etc) — they're reused. #### 7.
